图片内文字：
- Current development status for Survodutide
- From CMC perspective:
  - ✓ Formulations for AI & PEN will be different.
  - ✓ PFS is used in Phase 3 Obesity & MASH trials.
  - ✓ AI will be used for the initial Obesity NDA submission (in Dec. 2026).
  - ✓ PEN CMC Dossier will be ready by Oct 2027.
  - • Sample for PEN registration QC-testing will be ready by Oct 2027¹.
- From Clinical perspective:
  - ✓ Obesity Ph3 CTR will be available in Oct. 2026.
  - ✓ MASH Ph3 CTR (conditional approval) will be available in Q3, 2027.
  - ✓ MASH Ph3 CTR (full approval) will be available in Q3 2029.
  - ✓ 2 PK bridging studies are planned and under discussion
    - • PFS vs AI
    - • PFS vs PEN
    - • PFS VS PEN PK bridging study report will be ready by Mar 2026².
- PFS, Pre-filled Syringe; AI, auto injector (single dose pen); PEN, refers to multi-dose pen
- 1. The current plan will be consulted for HA’s opinion. Timeline will be further reevaluated based on HA’s feedback.
- 2. It is based on the current SRD design; the timeline will be further reevaluated based on HA’s feedback on design.
- The information above enable it possible to have MASH NDA submission with PEN.
- Boehringer Ingelheim
- * The assumption may be changed based on HA’s feedbacks on key issues on PK study design and QC-testing sample (expected Q3/Q4, 2025).
- 10

视觉关系：
- 页面分为两栏并列信息：左侧“From CMC perspective:”与右侧“From Clinical perspective:”对应同一项目的两类视角（CMC/临床）。
- 右栏临床时间节点存在先后顺序：
  - Obesity Ph3 CTR：Oct. 2026
  - MASH Ph3 CTR（conditional approval）：Q3, 2027
  - MASH Ph3 CTR（full approval）：Q3 2029
- 右栏“2 PK bridging studies”下包含两个子项（PFS vs AI、PFS vs PEN），并另有一个交付物节点：PFS VS PEN PK bridging study report（Mar 2026²）。
- 左栏包含CMC交付物时间节点：AI用于初次Obesity NDA提交（Dec. 2026）；PEN CMC Dossier（Oct 2027）；PEN注册QC-testing样品（Oct 2027¹）。
- 页面中部有红色矩形边框同时框选两栏各自的关键条目：左侧“Sample for PEN registration QC-testing...”与右侧“PFS VS PEN PK bridging study report...”强调两者。
- 底部结论句表述上述信息与“have MASH NDA submission with PEN”之间的支持关系（因果/支撑关系的文字表达）。
